The structure of LuSn₂Sb crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Lu₄Sn₈Sb₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Lu and Sb center has 12 Sn neighbors, while each Sn center has 4 Lu, 4 Sb, and 4 Sn neighbors, all at 3.2226 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Sn-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Lu- and Sb-centered polyhedra.
